meaning.return_to_study: Sends the file back to the rapporteur to finish studying it, with your reason.
meaning.require_completion: Asks for what the file is missing before it is presented; name what is needed.
meaning.send_to_legal_review: Hands the file to the legal member for an opinion before it goes on an agenda.
meaning.respond_accept: Confirms you can attend on the proposed date; the meeting is confirmed once the required number of members accept.
meaning.respond_decline: You can’t make the date; the meeting is confirmed only if enough other members accept, or the rapporteur proposes another date.
meaning.record_results: Enter each item's recommendation and approving authority as recorded at the meeting, and attach the signed minutes. The meeting closes and the requests go to their approving authorities.

decisionWizard.meetingPrompt: This meeting is waiting on an action from you.

ledger.respond_accept: The member accepted the meeting date.
ledger.respond_decline: The member declined the meeting date.
ledger.record_results: The committee's recommendations were entered and the minutes attached.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.legend: Dashed lines are exception paths; click any arrow or stage for its details.
workflows.selectStage: Pick a stage or arrow on the diagram, or a stage from the list:
workflows.unusedHint: No rule reaches or leaves it; kept for older requests' history.
workflows.drainOnlyHint: No rule reaches it; its rules only let files already here leave.

edit.cloneConfirm: This version is copied into a draft for editing; no request is affected until you publish it.
edit.anchorStage: Fixed step: the system relies on it, so it can't be deleted.
edit.builtinStageHint: Built-in step: its code and its place among the built-in steps stay, and it takes no checklist.
edit.builtinName: "{action}" is a built-in outcome: its name is fixed; everything else can change.
edit.deleteStageConfirm: The step and every outcome leaving it are deleted. A built-in step can only be brought back by deleting the draft.
edit.deleteBuiltinRuleConfirm: This built-in outcome will be deleted; only deleting the draft brings it back.
edit.requiresChecks: Taken only once the checklist is complete

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.hint: Completed by whoever takes an outcome that waits on it; never by the filer or the employee concerned.
checklist.noDocuments: The request types bound to this workflow list no documents.

edit.publishConfirm: This version applies to new requests only; requests already filed finish on their own version.
edit.discardConfirm: The draft and all its changes will be deleted.
edit.reportClean: No errors; the draft can be published.
edit.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
